remarks: North Stamford ranch set on a quiet cul-de-sac offering one-level living with a sun-filled walk-out lower level and private outdoor spaces. This beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 3 full-bath home welcomes you through mahogany French front doors into an open floor plan with hardwood floors, crown molding, and a spacious living room with fireplace. The chef's kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, travertine backsplash, custom cabinetry, and a wine cooler. French doors lead to a private deck ideal for outdoor dining. The primary suite includes its own deck, walk-in closet, and radiant-heated bath. The walk-out lower level offers a bedroom, full bath, media area, kitchenette, patio, and saltwater hot tub. Minutes to Merritt Parkway and High Ridge shopping including Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, fitness studios, golf, and Metro-North to NYC.
